print(f"Subtract 80 refunds of 96898 (total: {refunds_total}): {step4}")

# Step 5: Add 38 deposits of 93867
deposits_total = 38 * 93867
step5 = step4 + deposits_total
print(f"Add 38 deposits of 93867 (total: {deposits_total}): {step5}")

EOF
